newsitem.title: USA: USX extends exchange offer deadline.
newsitem.headline: USX extends exchange offer deadline.

text.p: USX Corp said on Tuesday it extended until May 15 the deadline to exchange 6.75 percent convertible quarterly income preferred securities of USX Capital Trust I for up to 6.7 million shares of its currently outstanding 6.50 percent cumulative convertible preferred stock.
As of Monday, about 3.9 million shares of the 6.50 percent cumulative convertible preferred stock had been deposited in response to the exchange offer, the company said.
USX Capital Trust I is a Delaware statutory business trust.
